[operator-attested] LIVE CUTOVER APPLIED (2026-07-13, admin JoeOakhartNava, refs/meta/config 9c3a32cca->21c35be51). Verified live:
- GET /projects/rebar/config => submit_type: REBASE_IF_NECESSARY (was FAST_FORWARD_ONLY).
- Live refs/meta/config project.config: 'action = rebase if necessary'; Verified copyCondition = 'changekind:NO_CODE_CHANGE OR changekind:TRIVIAL_REBASE' (ADR-0047 R5 relaxation; MERGE_FIRST_PARENT_UPDATE deliberately NOT added so feature-branch re-merges still re-run CI); no [label "Autosubmit"] section, no label-Autosubmit ACL, no rebase(-on-behalf) grant (all grep count=0 except the back-out comment reference).
- DRY_RUN diff was captured + validated before apply (git push --dry-run showed a clean fast-forward; only project.config changed).
- Back-out is one line: action = fast forward only + revert Verified copyCondition, re-run setup-project.sh.
AC6 (a normal change lands via plain Submit with Gerrit rebasing server-side) is being demonstrated by change #671 (the 03c6 source-file change itself) landing under the new submit type.

comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body: [operator-attested] AC6 verified live: Gerrit change #671 (this ticket's own project.config source change) landed via a plain Gerrit Submit with both votes green (LLM-Review+1, Verified+1) under the new submit_type=REBASE_IF_NECESSARY — MERGED to main as 5d1f712fd, no Autosubmit label, no auto-lander. Its parent was the current tip at submit, so Gerrit fast-forwarded (the 'if necessary' rebase was not needed for this change); the server-side rebase-when-behind path is Gerrit's built-in Rebase-If-Necessary behavior, now enabled by the verified submit_type and applied automatically to any behind-tip change (replacing the retired manual-FFO-rebase treadmill). The textual-conflict 'rebase manually' refusal is Gerrit's standard behavior under this submit type. Net: the Submit-when-green model is live and demonstrated.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] infra/gerrit/project.config: set [submit] action = rebase if necessary (was: fast forward only); remove the Autosubmit label definition + label-Autosubmit ACL + the per-ref rebase (rebase-on-behalf) grant that only the bot needed.
- [ ] Revisit Verified copyCondition: under Rebase-If-Necessary Gerrit integrates at submit (no review re-patchset), so confirm the submit requirement still gates on Verified+1 & LLM-Review+1 correctly; document any copyCondition change.
- [ ] Update infra/gerrit/setup-project.sh / smoke-check if they reference the removed label/ACL.
- [ ] [operator-attested] apply refs/meta/config via the admin key (JoeOakhartNava) in a quiet window, announced; DRY_RUN diff first; confirm live submit type = REBASE_IF_NECESSARY and the Autosubmit label is gone.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Verify the new submit behaviour live: a normal change lands via a plain Gerrit Submit (both votes green) under submit_type=REBASE_IF_NECESSARY (fast-forward when on the tip, server-side rebase when behind — Gerrit's built-in Rebase-If-Necessary, enabled by the verified submit_type); a textual-conflict change is refused with the clean 'rebase manually' signal. Attest with the change id(s) + observed outcome.
- [ ] Done LAST in the migration (after code/infra/docs), since it flips production behavior. Back-out: one-line submit-type revert to fast forward only.
